name: Southwest University of Science and Technology

evidence.summary: SWUST’s School of National Defence Science and Technology, formed in 2006 to serve the defence industry around Mianyang, is co-built by the Sichuan government and SASTIND.
The school hosts a national defence key discipline laboratory for nuclear waste and environmental safety (“核废物与环境安全”国防重点学科实验室).
items: Nuclear Waste and Environmental Safety Defence Key Discipline Laboratory (核废物与环境安全国防重点学科实验室)

evidence.summary: SASTIND approved its radiation protection and environmental protection discipline as one of the first defence-specialty core disciplines for 2016–2020.
The school reports comprehensive strategic cooperation with CAEP, the nuclear groups CNNC and CGN, NORINCO and CETC, and draws senior experts from CAEP, one of its co-founding board members.
